summary: The HPXPrinterDetails class is a UI page object model that represents the printer details screen in the HP Smart mobile application. It extends the SmartFlow base class and provides comprehensive automation methods for interacting with various printer-related features including scanning, printing, copying, faxing, and printer information management. The class contains 35 unique UI element locators and 38 methods that handle user interactions such as clicking tiles, verifying element visibility, retrieving printer information, and managing print jobs. Methods typically support configurable timeouts, exception handling, and swipe-based element discovery for scrollable interfaces. This class serves as a central automation interface for testing printer detail functionalities in the Android version of the HP Smart application.
